body:
Confirmed and fixed four incomplete-fix siblings in MeshChatX:
1. POST /api/v1/repository-server/refresh-bundled hit PyPI without privacy-mode gate (community/translator already gated).
2. extra_read_roots_from_app accepted / and $HOME as Landlock extra read roots (and symlink-to-/).
3. _teardown_all_contexts_for_reload did not call _clear_mesh_link_caches unlike teardown_identity.
4. /ws/telephone/audio GET upgrade bypassed demo-mode WS mutator list and could inject PCM.
Plugin zip directory-skip did not escape on Python 3.14 (stdlib sanitizes ..). Docs extract fuzz tests remain soft-fuzz.
title: Four niche incomplete-fix siblings
2026-08-14 deep hunt: CSWSH high, filesync ssl jail gap, Android SSL proceed, plugin integrity gaps
body:
Oracle-proven in tests/backend/test_ws_origin_filesync_oracles.py (3 failing secure-invariant tests, 2 passing controls).

1. HIGH CWE-346: /ws upgrade has no Origin check and no auth when auth disabled (default). Cross-site page drives mutators (config.set, lxmf.forwarding.rule.add message redirection, rns.link.* mesh impersonation). Config broadcast on connect leaks libretranslate_api_key. websocket_upgrade.py:138-186, middleware.py auth skips when auth_enabled false, meshchat.py:6705 _websocket_session_authorized returns True when auth disabled.
2. MEDIUM CWE-22: FileSync _resolve_sync_directory reservation list omits ssl, so <identity_storage>/ssl (TLS key.pem) is mesh-syncable via POST /api/v1/filesync/start or PATCH settings. rns_filesync_handler.py:68-143, key at meshchat.py:5382-5384.
3. MEDIUM-HIGH (code-confirmed, no runtime oracle, plain JUnit only): Android MainActivity.onReceivedSslError calls handler.proceed() for any SSL error when URL matches configured backend. Remote backend mode silently accepts MITM certs, exposing the 50-method MeshChatXAndroid bridge and session. MainActivity.java:307-321.
4. MEDIUM: plugin invoke/hook paths skip integrity re-check; WASM re-read from disk every invoke (plugin_manager.py:1284-1355). __pycache__/.pyc excluded from integrity hash (plugin_signature.py:38-48). Backend python plugins not danger-switched, permissions advisory only (plugin_python_runtime.py:73-88).
5. MEDIUM: repository_server_manager.py:171-176 PyPI wheel filename used as dest / fn with no basename jail; malicious PyPI metadata writes outside bundled dir.
6. MEDIUM deployment-dependent: /api/v1/auth/setup public while no password hash exists (first-caller squatting on exposed hosts). Demo mode seeds default password demo (demo_mode.py:38-39). ALTCHA solutions replayable within 300s window (altcha_auth.py).
Ruled out: zip slip in DB restore/KMZ/stickers, SQLi (all parameterized), command injection (no shell=True), main XSS sinks (DOMPurify/escapeHtml), invalid RSG install, XFF spoof with default empty trusted proxies, CSRF token handling (compare_digest, session-bound), session fixation on login.
